about_the_game:
Eclipsed Memories is a single-player, interactive story game, where you find and investigate supernatural cases, focusing on learning more about the characters and entities you face along the way.

Play as Liddy, a 20-something-year-old whose job solely depends on the paranormal activity in her small town.

Meet up with your friends at your spot, find cases by checking out News websites or by word of mouth, investigate the areas using your Supernatural Equipment, explore the town, talk to other people and figure out the best way to solve your cases, but keep in mind, the actions you take have consequences.

Some content warnings:

The game depicts themes of suicide, verbal and physical abuse, murder. It contains scary images that represent the entities you may deal with.

This game is purely fictional and any resemblance to real life is entirely coincidental.

content_descriptors.notes: In Eclipsed Memories, there are mentions of suicide and abuse of prescription drugs. There is also Supernatural violence and the killing/banishment of entities using rituals.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-4100 (dual-core/quad-thread, ~3 GHz)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X or Intel UHD 630 integrated graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (6 cores)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super / RTX 2060, or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT / 6600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

short_description: Every town is unique. Liddy's town has a lot of supernatural activity and it is her job to find and free entities stuck on our realm. Join her and her friends on their adventures, finding clues and ways to banish the creatures that shouldn't be here.
